aboutHero.heading: Ganka for Home: a touch of sophistication to your interior
aboutHero.description: Ganka Tretyak is a name that embodies the essence of creativity. As a true artist, she transforms her multifaceted career as a painter, film director, author, and cultural event organizer into a magical world of porcelain.

image.alt: Hand-painted plate depicting two birds among red rosehip berries

panel.paragraphs:
Ganka doesn’t just create, she reflects on all her experiences, bringing her unique perspective on life into every piece. 

 You can feel Ganka’s love for details in every element, her ability to turn everyday things into something special. Her work is a refined balance between form and color, embodying cheerfulness, tenderness, and kindness.

manifesto.quote: Everyday things, turned into something special.

artistGallery.heading: Artist Ganka: creativity in a unique form
artistGallery.description: Ganka knows how to add color to life like no one else. Her porcelain creations are full of lightness and playfulness, reflecting her ability to catch beauty in the simplest things.

images.alt: Plate illustrated with a rabbit and butterflies
Plate illustrated with a bird among red berries
Plate illustrated with red berries on branches
Plate with a textured silver-grey glazed rim

artOfLiving.heading: The art of living in your home
artOfLiving.description: Each product is not only a piece of her artistic soul, but also an invitation to a world where creativity becomes part of everyday life.

image.alt: Plate illustrated with a green dragon and a woman in a flowing gown

panel.paragraphs:
The artist suggests drawing daily inspiration from art and bright colors. Ganka's home collections will bring a festive atmosphere and warmth to your home. 

 Their artistic perfection adds elegance to every celebration, while the unique style highlights the special moments spent at the table with your loved ones.

values.heading: What we value
values.description: Three ideas guide every Ganka for Home piece, from the first sketch to your table.

items.title: Art for every day
items.description: Our illustrations are made to be used, not kept on a shelf: Ganka for Home tableware is designed for everyday meals as well as celebrations.

items.title: Ukrainian roots
items.description: The collections draw on images of Ukrainian culture and fairy-tale motifs, bringing a cheerful, familiar story into your home.

items.title: Attention to detail
items.description: Every element balances form and colour, so each piece feels considered — something to keep and enjoy for years.

ourStory.heading: Our story
ourStory.description: Ganka for Home collections combine images of Ukrainian culture with fairy tale motifs that will add a cheerful mood to your home. The bright illustration elements are designed for a festive atmosphere, since Ganka for Home tableware can be used every day.
